nodes.label: CI verify job
nodes.rationale: Runs build, i18n:check, typecheck, unit tests, guard, tracker verify and tracker report on every push/PR; uploads the tracker workbook as an artifact so the tracker never drifts from code.

nodes.label: CI integration job
nodes.rationale: Needs verify first; boots the compose datastores (postgres, memgraph, clickhouse, valkey, meilisearch, openbao) and runs every package's test:integration against the real stack.

nodes.label: OpenMap
nodes.rationale: Sovereign open-source replacement for Device42: discovery, dependency mapping, CMDB, IPAM/DNS/DHCP, DCIM, software/licence, vulnerability correlation, BSM, time travel, embedded Superset, AI assistant. One release, no phases.

nodes.label: No hardcoding rule
nodes.rationale: Every host, port, URL, path, credential, threshold, colour, label, model name comes from packages/config (zod-validated env), tenant settings in the DB, or packages/constants. A literal that could differ between deployments is a bug.

nodes.label: Fully functional, no dummy sections
nodes.rationale: No TODO/placeholder/mock in apps/ or packages/; every screen, endpoint, collector, job and report works end to end against the real compose stack.

nodes.label: Sovereign by default
nodes.rationale: No outbound network call at runtime except collectors to their targets and tenant-enabled integrations; the air-gapped compose profile must pass the full e2e suite.

nodes.label: Open source only, no product dependency
nodes.rationale: GPL/AGPL components run as separate processes, never linked; IPAM, DCIM and BSM are built in rather than delegated to NetBox, Grafana or an ITSM.
nodes.norm_label: open source only, no product dependency

nodes.label: Arabic/RTL and English from first commit
nodes.rationale: No user-facing string in code; every string is an i18n key with both locales filled so RTL is never retrofitted.
nodes.norm_label: arabic/rtl and english from first commit

nodes.label: Project memory files
nodes.rationale: CLAUDE.md, STATE.md, the tracker, GRAPH_REPORT.md, SPEC.md, ADRs and CONTRACTS.md are read at session start and written at session end so context is never lost; if STATE.md and tracker disagree the tracker wins.

nodes.label: OpenMap-Tracker.xlsx
nodes.rationale: Only edited through tools/tracker (ExcelJS CLI, pnpm tracker); no requirement exists unless it is a row; pnpm tracker verify blocks merges when a Done row lacks tests and evidence.

nodes.label: graphify knowledge graph
nodes.rationale: Structural memory of the codebase; docs/ is inside the graph so SPEC, ADRs and STATE link requirements to the code that implements them; REQ ids in commit messages and file headers form the links.

nodes.label: Definition of Done
nodes.rationale: Merged on main, unit+integration+e2e+k6 tests with IDs in the tracker, guard passes, en+ar keys with RTL screenshot, contracts bumped via ADR, OTel spans and Prometheus metric, works in airgap profile, STATE and graph refreshed.

nodes.label: pnpm guard (tools/guard)
nodes.rationale: Fails the build on forbidden tokens, any-casts, literal IPs/URLs/ports outside config, magic numbers in apps/, user-facing string literals in the console, files without a REQ header, and Done rows without evidence.

nodes.label: Contracts first
nodes.rationale: REQ-CORE-001…010 freeze packages/contracts before any other workstream starts, so parallel subagents per workstream can build against a stable CI schema, collector schema, GraphQL schema and event schema.

nodes.label: tools/synth-estate
nodes.rationale: Deterministic 100k-CI estate generator replayed through the real collector contract; a generator exercising the real pipeline, explicitly not a mock.

nodes.label: Performance targets
nodes.rationale: p95 under 100 ms per screen interaction, under 1 s for a 100k-node impact query, 60 fps graph rendering, 10k devices discovered in under 15 minutes; performance is a tracked requirement, not a tuning pass.

nodes.label: docs/SPEC.md
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for scope and architecture; wins over CLAUDE.md on disagreement.

nodes.label: Coding standards
nodes.rationale: TS strict + noUncheckedIndexedAccess; Go 1.23 with slog; NestJS one module per bounded context with outbox for every cross-store write; Next.js server components by default, TanStack Virtual lists, Sigma.js in a Web Worker; design tokens only.

nodes.label: @openmap/api
nodes.rationale: NestJS 11 on Fastify 5 with Mercurius serving the frozen schema-first GraphQL contract against Postgres (Prisma) and Memgraph (@openmap/graph); REQ-CORE-012. Config only from @openmap/config loadEnv().
nodes.community_name: Design cues taken from the AetherTwin prototype (Gemini / AI Studio)

nodes.label: API auth model (Keycloak JWT)
nodes.rationale: Every request carries a Keycloak-issued RS256 JWT verified with jose against the realm JWKS; issuer and client (azp/aud) checked; there is deliberately no auth-disabled mode, tests override the JWKS provider instead.

nodes.label: TenantContext
nodes.rationale: Request-scoped provider holding tenantId resolved from the token's tenant claim; every repository method takes tenantId first so no query can cross tenants.

nodes.label: Realm role hierarchy
nodes.rationale: openmap-admin ⊇ openmap-operator ⊇ openmap-analyst, openmap-auditor ⊇ openmap-analyst; mutations annotated with @Roles: CMDB/plan/asset/incident/scenario/discovery writes need operator, integration config needs admin, setLayerVisibility and askAssistant need analyst.

nodes.label: OutboxService.transaction
nodes.rationale: Business rows and outbox_events rows are written in the same Postgres transaction so a committed write always has its events and a rolled-back write leaves none; the API never writes to Memgraph, ClickHouse or Meilisearch directly, the reconciler drains and fans out.

nodes.label: CloudEvents 1.0 outbox envelope
nodes.rationale: Carries tenantid extension and traceparent from the active span; pending lists stores still to acknowledge (memgraph, clickhouse, meilisearch, websocket, bsm).

nodes.label: In-process EventBus and subscriptions
nodes.rationale: After commit envelopes are published on the EventBus; the subscriptions module forwards them to Mercurius pub/sub topics events, serviceHealthChanged, sweepProgress, scoped by tenant; connection_init must carry a valid token.

nodes.label: /healthz and /readyz probes
nodes.rationale: Readiness runs Postgres SELECT 1 and Memgraph RETURN 1 and returns 503 when either fails; intentionally unauthenticated along with the metrics route.
nodes.community_name: Design cues taken from the AetherTwin prototype (Gemini / AI Studio)

nodes.label: API Prometheus metrics
nodes.rationale: Served at METRICS_PATH: Node defaults, openmap_graphql_requests_total{operation,status}, openmap_graphql_duration_seconds.

nodes.label: runDiscovery mutation
nodes.rationale: Plans one scope per subnet CI (cidr, credentialRef, credentialType, exclusions) through @openmap/scheduler's planner and persists CollectorJobs as discovery_jobs.

nodes.label: OpenBao KV v2 credential resolution
nodes.rationale: Integration credentials are fetched at call time from ${OPENBAO_ADDR}/v1/${OPENBAO_MOUNT}/data/<credentialRef>; outbound calls additionally require FEATURE_OUTBOUND_INTEGRATIONS, a non-airgap profile and the tenant's outboundIntegrationsEnabled setting.

nodes.label: Business-service CI attributes and SLA
nodes.rationale: tier, usersAffected, revenuePerHour, slaTargetPercent etc. live on the CI; redundancy groups derive from part_of_service members grouped by redundancyGroup; SLA downtime is computed from openmap.bsm.health.changed events over a rolling 30-day window; health itself is read from Memgraph nodes in one batched query.

nodes.label: IPAM and DCIM graph conventions
nodes.rationale: Subnet CIs carry cidr and vrf; tree is CIDR containment within a VRF; ip_address CIs link via in_subnet; devices link to racks by located_in/mounted_on with startUnit/heightUnits/face; power feeds by powered_by with ratedWatts/currentWatts.

nodes.label: @openmap/console
nodes.rationale: Next.js 15 App Router, React 19, Tailwind v4, TanStack Query and Virtual on the Obsidian Pro design system; reads CONSOLE_PORT via loadEnv() in scripts/next.ts and derives NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL from PUBLIC_API_URL at build time so nothing in the package names a port or URL.

nodes.label: Locale routing ([locale] segment)
nodes.rationale: Routes under src/app/[locale]/ validated with isLocale; layout sets html lang/dir and mounts Providers; / redirects to /<DEFAULT_LOCALE>/dashboard read at request time; middleware prefixes paths lacking a locale; switcher swaps the first segment so the same screen reopens in the other language.

nodes.label: Generated Tailwind theme (gen-theme.ts)
nodes.rationale: src/app/theme.css is generated, not committed: scripts/gen-theme.ts writes themeCss() and stylesheet() from @openmap/ui so the console never carries raw tokens; runs in predev, prebuild and typecheck.

nodes.label: stamp-next-env.ts postbuild

nodes.label: Discovery Node enrolment over mTLS
nodes.rationale: node-register.js issues a one-time token; the Node runs enrol with OPENMAP_ENROL_TOKEN. Nodes only connect outbound to the scheduler over mTLS so no inbound port is opened at a site; in compose the Node trusts the scheduler via the shared scheduler-pki volume (OPENMAP_BOOTSTRAP_CA_PATH), remote sites receive ca.crt out of band. The scheduler cert names PUBLIC_SCHEDULER_URL's host plus SCHEDULER_TLS_EXTRA_SANS so in-network and external Nodes both verify it.

nodes.label: Impact query shape
nodes.rationale: Edges point from dependant to dependency so impact flows against the arrows: MATCH (c:Ci)<-[:DEPENDS_ON|RUNS_ON|POWERED_BY|HOSTED_ON*1..$depth]-(x)-[:PART_OF_SERVICE]->(s:BusinessService); power and rack scenarios expand the failed set first via LOCATED_IN then reuse the shape with WHERE c.id IN $ids; $depth from ImpactScenario.options.maxDepth.

nodes.label: BusinessService.impactedBy triggers
nodes.rationale: Three AFTER COMMIT triggers (edge create, edge delete, service create) maintain the count of distinct CIs whose failure reaches a service within {impact_closure_depth} hops, so the console shows blast radius per row without a traversal per row.

nodes.rationale: Substituted by the runner from src/parameters.ts because a Cypher variable-length range bound must be a literal.
